jobFinance.title: Job billing and costs
jobFinance.partialLoadFailed: Some job finance information could not be loaded. The available sections remain usable.
jobFinance.roles: Operations prepares vendor bills, purchase orders, client invoices and the final account. Finance approves vendor bills, client invoices and the final account; Management approves purchase orders.

estimate.title: Estimate and budget
estimate.hint: The costing behind the accepted quotation. Its cost side is the job budget that actual expenses are compared with.

extra.title: 48-hour clock and extra hours
extra.hint: The clock runs from the tug leaving the jetty with the fenders until it returns with them. Hours beyond the included basis are charged to the owners at the tariff rate.
extra.exceeded: The operation has passed the {{hours}} included hours. Send the additional hours to the owners.
extra.final: The clock is final; the extra charge can be invoiced.
extra.pendingTerms: Extra-hour billing is unavailable until the accepted tariff's billing increment, grace period and rounding rule are confirmed.
extra.running: The clock is not final yet. The extra charge can be invoiced once the tug is back and the clock is final.
extra.none: The clock starts when the first tug movement with the fenders is recorded.
extra.noticeAction: Open notice in Tug and clock

noticeStatus.RELEASED: Ready for Operations to record delivery

jobFinance.evidenceRequired: Required for vendor bills before submitting
jobFinance.invoiceRequired: Vendor invoice attachment required before submitting (click Edit to attach)
jobFinance.replaceQuoteLines: Replace the cost lines already entered with lines from the Quote?
jobFinance.empty: No cost documents for this job.
jobFinance.fdaSubmittedByYou: Submitted and awaiting approval by Finance. Under the 4-eyes rule, a different user (Finance) must approve it.
jobFinance.liveFda: Live figures from issued client invoices and approved vendor bills. The FDA PDF lists each source document.
jobFinance.draftFda: Draft FDA — number assigned at issue
jobFinance.noExternalCosts: Reason if there are no third-party actual costs
jobFinance.varianceToCommitment: Actual minus the higher of budget and commitment
jobFinance.extraHoursNote: Why extra hours are not billed (required while the clock is not final or the tariff terms are pending)
jobFinance.onAccount: Client receipts held on account (not allocated to any invoice): {{currency}} {{amount}}

finance.extraCostHead: Revenue cost head for extra hours
finance.listSubtitle: Invoices and credit notes within your scope, newest first.
finance.search: Search by invoice number, billing name or job number
finance.jobEmpty: No invoices for this job yet.
finance.chooseInvoiceJob: Select the job to create an invoice. Invoice creation is available for jobs in your branch.
finance.fromQuotation: New invoice from the accepted quotation
finance.noAcceptedQuotation: This job has no accepted quotation, so an invoice starts blank.
finance.approveHint: Approving confirms the lines and totals. You cannot approve a document you submitted yourself.
finance.returnHint: The document goes back to draft. Say what needs to change.
finance.issueHint: Issuing assigns the next number from the series and stores the PDF. An issued document can never be changed; corrections are made with a credit note.
finance.liveTotals: Totals update as you type; the saved figures are calculated by the server.
finance.dueDateHint: Entered by hand: the payment terms are free text, so no due-date rule is applied.
finance.extraHoursHint: Extra hours: add a supplementary line by hand. It will be linked to the charging clock in a later increment.
finance.receiptsSubtitle: Money received from clients and the invoices it pays.
finance.choosePartyHint: Clients with open issued invoices. A receipt is in the invoice currency.
finance.noParties: There are no open issued invoices to receive payment for.
finance.noOpenInvoices: No open invoices for this client.
finance.overAllocated: The allocations are more than the amount received.
finance.reverseHint: The receipt and its allocations stop counting; the invoices are open again. A receipt is never deleted.
finance.receivablesSubtitle: Open issued invoices aged from their due date.
finance.bucketsHint: Ageing buckets are provisional until Ship2Ship confirms them.
finance.noReceivables: Nothing is open on this day.

costDocsSubtitle.PO: Commitments to vendors across your jobs, newest first.
costDocsSubtitle.BILL: Approved and pending vendor bills across your jobs, newest first.

finance.costSearch: Search by number, reference, vendor or job
finance.profitSubtitle: Income, actual cost and margin per job, each in its own currency. Income and cost are net of tax.
